# Singularity visual reference boundary

Approved visual reference: <https://singularity.misterprada.com/>

Reference repository: <https://github.com/MisterPrada/singularity>

The reference repository did not expose an explicit license when this integration was reviewed on 2026-08-05. No source code, shader, texture, or model from that repository is copied here.

`singularity-core.glsl` is an independent hall-specific implementation of the approved rendering structure: bent volume marching, orbiting procedural gas, warm emission, a dark core, and transparent compositing. Its JavaScript/WebGL owner is `../../components/BlackHoleFlow.ts`.
